title: Cancel obsolete chess searches and predict only the current position

source.summary: When a chess position becomes irrelevant, abort its processing and remove queued work. Predictions follow only the current position, especially in Free both sides.

outOfScope: New chess engines or a different hosting provider
New visual design, evaluation calibration or gameplay rules
Global cancellation across unrelated clients or Vercel instances
Historical prediction cache or speculative future-position analysis

references.adopt: Cooperative per-operation cancellation with already-aborted checks and listener cleanup
references.reject: Assuming abort alone invalidates already delivered results

references.adopt: Propagate cancellation from the response consumer to the producer job
references.reject: Closing the UI stream while continuing hidden inference

references.adopt: Stop active UCI search and drain its bestmove before reusing the serial command channel
references.reject: Treating readyok as a search completion barrier

references.adopt: Explicit per-function supportsCancellation and preregistered after/waitUntil lifetime for bounded engine cleanup after disconnect
references.reject: Assuming standalone Node abort behavior automatically applies to Vercel or using broad cancellation on unrelated mutation routes

requirements.title: Only current-position work reaches the board
requirements.expected: Accepted moves, undo, New game, mode/model/search-setting changes and unmount immediately invalidate and abort obsolete hint, evaluation and automatic-move work. Same-FEN revisit has a fresh generation. Never display or act on old suggestions, arrows, balance, progress, errors or late automatic moves. Invalid move/selection alone must not cancel useful work. At most one current request per purpose; no past-position backlog.

requirements.title: Canceled jobs leave the actual runtime
requirements.expected: Queued cancellation rejects promptly before the active job finishes, removes the job and releases capacity immediately. Active cancellation rejects promptly and suppresses progress; UCI stop drains bestmove before another go. A silent stop is bounded to at most 1 second before kill/restart. Cancellation during startup/readiness kills only the active process and advances valid queued clients. Preserve FIFO isolation, process reuse and two-hour idle lifecycle; no cross-client cancellation.

requirements.title: Disconnect cancels inference end to end
requirements.expected: Request abort and response-stream cancel both abort an owned work signal forwarded by analysis and model-move routes. Pre-aborted work never runs. JSON and SSE client paths reject late results/progress after abort, cancel readers, release listeners and honor timeout. No hanging cancellation promises or unhandled stream writes. Vercel cancellation is explicitly enabled only for analysis and model-move function source paths. Before returning the response, register Next after retention that waits for actual runtime queue removal/channel cleanup, rather than the promptly rejected caller. Retention settles for preabort, queued cancellation, busy/error and normal completion; no retained obsolete inference beyond bounded cleanup.

requirements.title: Truthful current loading and recovery
requirements.expected: Automatic invalidation does not flash obsolete errors. Current loading identifies the selected engine; Cancel stops current work and offers Retry. Board remains responsive in Free both sides, including rapid alternating moves; empty stale hints until new result. Current hint/model auto response and arena still work for all built-in UCI engines. Existing requested/narrow glass layout and accessible controls remain.

requirements.title: Source-bound request, candidate and deployed acceptance
requirements.expected: Independent readiness, exact-tree candidate review/full required CI, fresh deployed critical scenarios and independent acceptance. Retain logs, viewport sequences, reference notes and receipts with PR.

actions: Hold an active search; cancel more than queue capacity worth of obsolete waiting jobs, then admit a valid other-client job

Cancel Request and stream consumer independently; exercise pre-abort, late JSON/SSE progress/result and timeout paths

Verify cancellation-enabled Vercel path rules match both inference routes and exclude unrelated mutation routes; retained cleanup registered before stream/work and settles only after actual drain/removal, including early failures

Cancellation reaches actual work signal, request parser never publishes obsolete output, all listeners/readers/timers clean up
Provider configuration and lifecycle adapter prevent disconnect from reclaiming asynchronous engine cleanup prematurely

risks.risk: Vercel processes are shared and distributed; a new request must not cancel another player
risks.resolution: Cancellation is owned by the requesting operation/window. Preserve unrelated FIFO jobs; no global latest-FEN singleton. Live HTTP abort timing is observational; direct transport/runtime tests establish cancellation paths.

risks.risk: Canceled search late output can contaminate the next search
risks.resolution: Drain stop to bestmove before the next go; bounded drain timeout kills the process before next job. Startup/readiness cancellation is bounded and cannot strand queued jobs.

risks.risk: A position can return to the same FEN after reset/undo
risks.resolution: Use request generation/epoch identity, not just FEN. Invalidate synchronously on accepted actions and relevant settings; abort before replacement starts.

risks.risk: Promise completion/progress may race abort or ignore the transport signal
risks.resolution: Check operation relevance and signal before any progress/error/result state update; reject already-aborted work before fetch/spawn; cancel read stream and clean listeners.

risks.risk: Automatic stale cancellation may show error flicker or leave no prediction on current board
risks.resolution: Obsolete jobs are silent; current position gets only its own loading/progress/result. Explicit Cancel remains a stopped state with Retry, not an automatic restart loop.

risks.risk: Vercel cancellation is opt-in and a disconnected invocation can be reclaimed before asynchronous stop/drain completes
risks.resolution: Enable supportsCancellation on only the two inference function patterns. Register Next after before stream/work; retain a promise covering actual runtime release/removal, not just response/caller completion. Require configuration scope tests and successful Vercel preview build; live cancel/replace checks remain observational under distributed routing.

rollbackTriggers: Stale predictions or automatic moves affect a changed board
Shared-engine queue stalls or unrelated clients are canceled
rollout.hotfixPolicy: Isolated recoverable defects block acceptance until an evidenced hotfix; rollback broken primary interaction or unrecoverable queue.
